title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: AI email classification by category and subcategory
summary: Hold: the automation column for choosing classification timing gives an action that classifies an email, not an operation that changes the timing setting. The roadmap facts, admin paths and pay-as-you-go prerequisite are supported; the taxonomy path also needs its final steps.

claims.claim: Customer Service email classification uses AI to assign incoming emails to administrator-defined categories and subcategories.
claims.quote: Email classification analyzes the content of incoming emails and assigns each message to a configured category.

claims.claim: Learn describes five setup tasks: taxonomy, scope, timing and enablement, simulation, and downstream use.
claims.quote: Configuring email classification involves five high-level tasks:

claims.claim: At least two categories must be configured.

claims.claim: The hierarchy supports up to four levels.
claims.quote: the hierarchy can contain up to four levels.

claims.claim: The enablement path is Copilot Service admin center > Email settings > Email classification > Manage > Enable feature > Turn on email classification.
claims.quote: go to Email settings > Email classification, and then select Manage. ... Under Enable feature, select Turn on email classification.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API to set Turn on email classification as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'email classification configuration isenabled API Dynamics' and 'Dynamics 365 email classification Turn on email classification API setting organization msdyn configuration scope qualification'; read configuration, custom action and category references; no enable-setting operation found.

claims.claim: The taxonomy path is Copilot Service admin center > Email settings > Email classification > Manage > Define taxonomy.
claims.quote: In Define taxonomy, select + Add. ... To create a subcategory, in Parent, select the category directly above it in the hierarchy.
claims.fix: Complete controls[1].ui.path as 'Email settings > Email classification > Manage > Define taxonomy > + Add > Add category > Parent' for subcategory creation; the current path stops on the correct page before the controls. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-email-classification.

claims.quote: Create ... POST /msdyn_emailclassificationcategories

claims.claim: The email eligibility path is Copilot Service admin center > Email settings > Email classification > Manage > Choose which emails to categorize > Manage rule.
claims.quote: go to Email settings > Email classification, and then select Manage. ... Under Choose which emails to categorize, select Manage rule.

claims.claim: No API is documented for the qualifying-email scope condition as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'email classification scope msdyn condition' and 'email classification scope conditions API table enable'; read configuration, custom action and scope-rule reference excerpts. The latter limits candidate categories, not which inbound emails are evaluated; no matching setting API found.

claims.claim: The eligibility rule supports one condition with multiple clauses.
claims.quote: You can create one condition with multiple clauses.

claims.claim: An email must meet all clauses to be classified.
claims.quote: An email must meet all the clauses to be classified.

claims.claim: The timing option is reached through Copilot Service admin center > Email settings > Email classification > Manage > Choose when to categorize emails > In your own customization using API.
claims.quote: Under Choose when to categorize emails, select one of the following options: ... In your own customization using API: Allows your custom automation to control when emails are classified.

claims.claim: POST /api/data/v9.2/msdyn_EmailClassificationCustomAction is the automation equivalent of choosing whether custom automation rather than arrival triggers classification.
claims.quote: Use the msdyn_EmailClassificationCustomAction Dataverse action to analyze an existing email record ... The action updates the Email category (AI) and Classification Status fields on the email record.
claims.fix: Set controls[3].api to null: the documented POST endpoint exists, but classifies an individual email rather than setting the timing option. Replace its note with 'Select this option in the admin app before configuring custom automation; the msdyn_EmailClassificationCustomAction action classifies an existing email record.' Keep the custom-action source link in sources.

claims.claim: The custom action classifies one existing email rather than selecting the timing option.
claims.quote: Use the msdyn_EmailClassificationCustomAction Dataverse action to analyze an existing email record and assign one of the active email categories configured for your organization.

claims.claim: The action accepts the emailId request parameter.
claims.quote: emailId | String | Yes | GUID of an existing Dataverse email record.

claims.claim: The action accepts the doRuleEvaluation request parameter.
claims.quote: doRuleEvaluation | Boolean | Yes | Determines whether the configured email classification conditions are evaluated.

claims.claim: As soon as they arrive automatically classifies qualifying incoming emails.
claims.quote: As soon as they arrive: Automatically classifies qualifying incoming emails.
